build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && npm run sidecar:build

security.csp: default-src 'self' customprotocol: asset:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: MCP-ready SSH, serial, and terminal workspace
bundle.longDescription: PortMate is a cross-platform terminal workspace for SSH, serial, Telnet, raw TCP, Tmux, file transfer, diagnostics, and local MCP session control.
